{{samename|character from {{vg|Pokémon Ranger}}|Freddie}} {{CharInfobox| |color={{normal color}} |corecolor={{normal color light}} |bordercolor={{normal color dark}} |name=Freddy O'Martian |jname=タケミツ |tmname=Takemitsu |image=Freddy O Martian.png |caption=Freddy O'Martian |colors=yes |eyes=Black |hair=Dark blue |size=250px |region=[[Unova]] |gender=Male |anime=yes |epnum=BW039 |epname=Reunion Battles In Nimbasa! |enva=[[Tom Wayland]] |java=[[Mitsuaki Madono]] |}} '''Freddy O'Martian''' (Japanese: '''タケミツ''' ''Takemitsu'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}. He is an announcer who hosts various {{cat|Pokémon competitions}} throughout the [[Unova]] [[region]] and the [[Decolore Islands]]. He also goes by the nickname "The Scoop". ==History== Freddy first appeared from ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]'' to ''[[BW042|Club Battle Finale: A Hero's Outcome!]]''. He was the co-announcer for the [[Club Battle]] tournament, working alongside the [[Don George]] of [[Nimbasa Town]]. From ''[[BW070|The Clubsplosion Begins!]]'' to ''[[BW073|Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown!]]'', Freddy was the co-announcer for the [[Clubsplosion]]. He once again worked alongside a Don George, this time the one from [[Ambiga Town]]. From ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'' to ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'', Freddy was the co-host of the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]]. This time, he provided commentary for the competition alongside [[Alder]]. From ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'' to ''[[BW108|A Unova League Evolution!]]'', Freddy hosted the [[Vertress Conference]]. At the commencement of the opening ceremonies, he entered the stadium by parachuting from a helicopter. He reappeared for the final time in ''[[BW126|Crowning the Scalchop King!]]'', where he hosted the [[Scalchop King Competition]] at [[Scalchop Island]] in the [[Decolore Islands]]. ==Character== Freddy appears to be the go-to guy when it comes to hosting tournaments. He has acted as the announcer for several {{cat|Pokémon competitions}} during ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'', from small ones such as {{to|Ambiga}}'s [[Clubsplosion]], to major events that attract a large group of {{pkmn|Trainer}}s, such as [[Unova]]'s {{pkmn|League Conference}}, the [[Vertress Conference]]. He is very enthusiastic and his style is similar to that of a {{wp|sports commentator}}.
